recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, medium-close-up portrait of a young man with styled hair, set against a deep, near-black background. The subject is lit with warm, directional light that creates soft shadows on one side of the face. Typography is stacked in the upper-left corner using a condensed, high-contrast serif font in two distinct colors.
coreVisualRelationships: The subject's gaze is directed slightly off-camera, creating a sense of introspection.
The warm skin tones contrast sharply with the cool blue and warm gold of the text.
The dark clothing of the subject blends into the background, emphasizing the face and the typography.
The vertical stack of text balances the horizontal weight of the subject's shoulders.
coreInvariants: Deep black or dark brown negative space
Warm, soft-focus studio lighting on the face
Left-aligned, vertically stacked condensed serif typography
Two-tone color split for the text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright gold text in the top left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top-left text, moves down the typography, then across to the subject's face and eyes.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy negative space on the left and bottom, used to house text and provide depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black/brown background and dark clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm peach and tan skin tones.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold and sky blue for the primary typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the background with high-value highlights on the skin; typography uses medium-saturation primary colors.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance
Limit to earth tones and muted 1960s primaries

letterConstructionRules: Significant stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family using color to differentiate hierarchy.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the extreme verticality and high contrast of the period.
Provides the classic bookish but bold feel of 60s album art.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio portrait of a young man with 1950s/60s styled hair, wearing a dark shirt, against a solid black background. Use warm, soft directional lighting from the right to highlight facial features while leaving the left side in deep shadow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add five lines of left-aligned, vertically stacked text in the top-left corner. Use a bold, condensed serif font. Set the first three lines in a muted gold color and the bottom two lines in a sky blue color. Ensure tight leading so the lines almost touch.

verificationChecks: Is the text left-aligned and stacked vertically?
Does the lighting on the face feel warm and analog?
Is the background a deep, uniform dark color?
Are the two text colors distinct but muted?

adjustableVariables: Specific hues of the gold and blue text
postGenerationChecks: Check for condensed serif font accuracy
Verify the color split in the typography
Ensure the subject's clothing blends into the background
Confirm the composition leaves enough negative space for text
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Dark Negative Space + Stacked Condensed Serif + Two-Tone Color Hierarchy
